verdict.rationale: Google's docs describe a lost-phone recovery path: sign in to your Google Account in Authenticator, and when you sign in on a new device your codes sync to it automatically, which the docs say protects you from being locked out when you change devices. Community complaints that codes weren't included in phone backups, or were wiped by old app upgrades, concern other mechanisms or older versions and don't contradict account sync. The manual QR transfer needs the old device, so it only helps a lost phone if exported beforehand, as one user did by printing the QR code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that account sync restores codes on a new device; sync is opt-in (the docs offer "Use without an account") and must be enabled before the phone is lost.
